items.name: React 18 & TypeScript (Strict Mode)
items.desc: Built with strongly typed interfaces (Profile, Project, Experience, SiteArchitectureCategory, ThemeMode) ensuring compile-time safety and zero any types.

items.name: Vite 5 Build Engine
items.desc: Configured with lightning-fast HMR and optimized production bundle chunking (< 180kB JS / 9kB CSS).

items.name: React Router 6 (Client-Side SPA Routing)
items.desc: Declarative routing with <Routes> and <Route> wrapped in a global LayoutRenderer context.

items.name: GitHub REST API Integration & sessionStorage Caching Layer
items.desc: Real-time GitHub activity integration fetching user profile & repository metrics (api.github.com), 15-minute per-username sessionStorage TTL caching, custom React hook (useGitHubData), and 30-day activity highlight filters.

items.name: Multi-Theme Architecture (Modern Editorial, ASCII Box & CLI Terminal)
items.desc: Stateful 3-way theme switching using React Context (ThemeContext) with localStorage persistence and CSS variable design tokens (data-theme="modern", "ascii", and "cli").

items.name: Pure Vanilla CSS & Monospace Typography
items.desc: Custom CSS resets, responsive grid/flexbox layouts, Google JetBrains Mono font loading, and retro terminal styling without heavy UI library dependencies.

items.name: Vitest + React Testing Library + happy-dom
items.desc: In-memory unit tests for component rendering, static data layers, router navigation, and interactive tag filtering.

items.name: Playwright E2E Integration Testing
items.desc: Automated real Chrome browser tests verifying user navigation flows, theme toggle persistence, interactive filtering, and 404 page fallback.

items.name: Storybook 10 & Accessibility (a11y) Audits
items.desc: Isolated component visual development and @storybook/addon-a11y accessibility validation (.sr-only utility, ARIA landmark roles, and high contrast visible focus rings).

items.name: Python 3.11 & FastAPI REST Microservice
items.desc: Decoupled backend API service serving profile details, curated projects, reading entries, and server-side GitHub stats proxy.

items.name: Pydantic v2 Schemas & Data Contracts
items.desc: Strict input and output validation models ensuring type-safe JSON API contracts across all endpoints.

items.name: Server-Side GitHub Proxy & 15-Minute Cache
items.desc: Async HTTPX service fetching GitHub stats server-side with a 15-minute in-memory TTL cache to eliminate client-side rate limits.

items.name: Interactive Swagger UI & ReDoc Documentation
items.desc: Auto-generated OpenAPI 3.0 documentation available at /docs and /redoc for testing and API discovery.

items.name: SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM & Alembic Schema Migrations
items.desc: Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) models for Projects, Technologies, Now Entries, and Reading Items, with automated Alembic schema migration management.

items.name: Environment-Aware Dual Database Architecture (SQLite & Aiven PostgreSQL)
items.desc: Local development operates on a zero-config SQLite file database (personal_os.db), while production connects to a managed, free-tier Aiven PostgreSQL instance.

items.name: Resilient Fallback Mechanism & Seeding Pipeline
items.desc: Idempotent JSON-to-SQL seeding pipeline (seed.py) and robust API fallback handlers returning local static data if the database is unseeded or unreachable.

items.name: React Frontend SPA (https://chrislau.dev)
items.desc: Deployed statically on Cloudflare Pages (Root: frontend, Build: npm run build, Output: dist) with global CDN distribution and SSL.

items.name: Live Component Storybook (https://chris-lau-storybook.pages.dev)
items.desc: Deployed on Cloudflare Pages (Root: frontend, Build: npm run build-storybook, Output: storybook-static) providing a live isolated UI library.

items.name: FastAPI Backend & Interactive Swagger UI (/docs)
items.desc: Containerized multi-stage Docker deployment on Render (Root: backend, python:3.11-slim) serving REST endpoints and live Swagger UI at /docs.

items.name: Request Correlation & UUIDv4 Tracing (X-Request-ID)
items.desc: CorrelationIDMiddleware generating and propagating unique UUIDv4 headers for end-to-end request tracing across all API calls.

items.name: Structured JSON Access Logging to stdout
items.desc: RequestLoggingMiddleware emitting machine-readable JSON logs containing timestamp, request_id, method, path, status_code, latency_ms, client_ip, and user_agent.

items.name: Sub-System Health & Readiness Probes (/health/live, /health/ready, /api/v1/telemetry)
items.desc: Differentiated process liveness, deep sub-system readiness inspecting RAM RSS memory (MB) and uptime, and slowapi rate-limiter budget telemetry.

items.name: Browser Real User Monitoring (RUM) & Storage Audits
items.desc: Client utilities auditing TTFB ms, DOM node count, JS heap memory usage, sessionStorage byte size, and GitHub proxy cache age.

items.name: Live Full-Stack Monitoring Console & Automated 5-Step Synthetic Diagnostic Runner
items.desc: Dedicated /monitoring page featuring live system topology map (React SPA ➔ FastAPI Backend ➔ GitHub API) and an automated 5-step synthetic E2E diagnostic test runner.

items.name: Retrieval-Grounded Chat Engine (~71K Context Grounding)
items.desc: Visitor-facing Q&A grounded in blog posts, guidebooks, and resume data via a unified OpenAI-compatible SDK interface supporting Gemini, DeepSeek, and OpenAI models.

items.name: Server-Sent Events (SSE) Streaming & Defensive Rate Limiting
items.desc: Token-by-token streaming over SSE with IP-based per-minute and per-day rate limiting, defensive system prompts, and sliding conversation history bounds.

items.name: Split-Panel Companion Observability Console
items.desc: Desktop split-panel and mobile tabbed companion console tracking session summaries, live chunk streaming throughput, latency sparklines, and per-message token/cost accounting.

items.name: Two-Segment TTFT Decomposition & Timing Telemetry
items.desc: Real-time client TTFT breakdown decomposing total latency into Network RTT, Backend Prompt Build / Routing Overhead (server_pre_llm_ms), and LLM Prefill to First Token (server_llm_to_first_token_ms).

items.name: Niche Opportunity Finder
items.desc: Interactive discovery tool analyzing 12 high-velocity product niches with customizable demand vs. competition scoring, search volume filters, and category toggles.

items.name: 2026 FBA Unit Economics & Profit Margin Calculator
items.desc: Dynamic financial simulator modeling accurate 2026 Amazon fulfillment fee tiers, category-specific referral rates, TACoS ad spend, landed COGS, and breakeven margins.

items.name: Competitor Review Sentiment & Gap Analysis
items.desc: Product intelligence dashboard synthesizing sentiment weaknesses across 100+ customer reviews with instant AI prompt generation for product redesign.

items.name: Keyword Velocity & Trends Explorer
items.desc: Search volume tracking and growth velocity indicator identifying trending product terms before seasonal demand spikes.
